sources.title: Enfield sets out ambitious 10-year new homes plan to tackle housing crisis
sources.verified_claim: Cabinet agreed a 2026–2036 Housing Delivery and Placemaking Ten-Year Plan with a roadmap for 3,000 high-quality affordable homes and well-connected communities.

sources.title: Current schemes — Meridian Water
sources.verified_claim: Enfield describes Meridian Water as aiming for 10,000 homes and thousands of jobs; Meridian One A has 301 homes and further phases/infrastructure works are progressing.

sources.title: Final residents move into Meridian One A as construction is completed
sources.verified_claim: Meridian One A construction completed with 301 homes, establishing the first completed residential neighbourhood within Meridian Water.

sources.title: Angel Way development approved at Strategic Planning Committee
sources.verified_claim: Strategic Planning Committee approved the Angel Way regeneration proposal for 106 homes, commercial opportunities and improved public realm in Romford town centre.

sources.title: Local Plan update
sources.verified_claim: Havering says its Local Plan update is at the evidence-review and collection stage, including identifying sites suitable for new homes.

sources.title: Notice of intention to commence Local Plan
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth published notice on 16 July 2026 of its intention to prepare the Lambeth Local Plan 2029; preparation is expected to begin on 31 October 2026.

sources.title: Call for Sites
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth ran a Call for Sites from 19 January to 20 March 2026 to identify land potentially available for housing, commercial uses and growth-supporting infrastructure.

sources.title: Waterloo opportunity area
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth states significant growth is anticipated in Waterloo, including 15,000 new jobs and 1,900 new homes, alongside transport and public-realm investment.
